name: docker-lsp
description: Language servers that run inside this repo's dev container, never on the host.

args: d="$1"; shift; docker compose -f "$d/docker-compose.dev.yml" --project-directory "$d" up -d --no-build --no-recreate dev >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker compose -f "$d/docker-compose.dev.yml" --project-directory "$d" exec -T dev "$@"
